deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematical derivation. It continues lecture-style notes on descriptive crystallography and mineralogy, in the same series as the previous page (octahedra, rhombohedra, and so on). It reads like notes taken from a lecture or textbook in the Werner/Weiss tradition, not original mathematics. Content, section by section:

(1) End of the rhombohedron description begun on the previous page. A rhombohedron is bounded by 6 congruent rhombi and has two kinds of corners:
- two 'end corners', each made of three equal plane angles;
- six lateral corners, each with two equal angles and one unequal angle.
The edges meeting the end corners are one kind; the others are the 'Grundkanten' (lateral or basal edges).

(2) Classification of rhombohedra:
- (a) obtuse rhombohedra, with obtuse end corners;
- (b) acute rhombohedra, with acute end corners;
- the cube lies 'in the middle' between them.
In modern terms: let α be the plane angle at the threefold end corner. The rhombohedron is obtuse for α > π/2 and acute for α < π/2. The cube (α = π/2) is the borderline case where all corners become equivalent. This is my gloss of the verbal statement.

(3) 'Abänderungen der einfacheren Grundformen' (modifications of the simple basic forms):
- Type 1: a change in the mutual inclination of the faces, which moves one form continuously into another. Example: the passage of a (pyramidal) octahedron-type form into the regular octahedron.
- Type 2: new faces, not belonging to the main form, are added (combination forms). Its sub-types, in Werner's terminology, are:
  - Abstumpfung (truncation): an edge or corner is replaced by a new face;
  - Zuschärfung (bevelling): an edge or corner is replaced by two faces meeting in an edge;
  - Zuspitzung (acumination): a corner is replaced by several faces meeting in a point.
- Definition given: Abstumpfung is the change in which some part (an edge or a corner) is replaced by a new face.

There is nothing to compute. The page records standard 19th-century crystallographic terminology.

results.what: Classification of rhombohedra into obtuse and acute, with the cube as the limiting/intermediate case
results.modern_name: Rhombohedral forms (trigonal system); cube as the rhombohedron with 90° face angles
results.usually_credited_to: Standard crystallography (Haüy, Weiss, Mohs, early 19th century)

results.what: Modifications of crystal forms: truncation, bevelling, acumination (Abstumpfung, Zuschärfung, Zuspitzung)
results.modern_name: Combination forms / crystal habit modification terminology
results.usually_credited_to: A. G. Werner (late 18th century) descriptive mineralogy

deep.surprise_reason: These are student-style notes on standard descriptive crystallography and Werner's nomenclature. There is no original mathematics, and nothing here is unexpected for a Göttingen student who attended natural-science lectures.

checkable.asserts: The unit rhombohedron with plane angle pi/2 at the end corners has volume 1, i.e. it is the unit cube: the borderline between obtuse and acute rhombohedra.
Equals 0: the obtuse rhombohedra degenerate (volume to 0) as the end-corner plane angle approaches 2*pi/3. This bounds the obtuse family; it is context, not on the page.

transcription_corrections: Line 3/4: 'stumpfe Scalenoeder' and 'spitze Scalenoeder' should most likely read 'stumpfen Endecken' and 'spitzen Endecken' (obtuse/acute end corners). Rhombohedra are classified by their end corners, which fits 'zwischen denen der Würfel in der Mitte liegt'.
Line 2: 'Scalenoedern[?]' is doubtful. The word before 'die Rhomboeder zerfallen in' looks more like 'Geradkanten/Gerandkanten' (a continuation of the edge naming) than 'Scalenoedern'.
'(u. Weiss'sche Nomenclatur)' should read '(n. Werner's Nomenclatur)', i.e. 'nach Werners Nomenclatur'. Abstumpfung, Zuschärfung and Zuspitzung are Werner's terms.
'Leucitoid Pentagondodekaeder' is uncertain; it is probably a 'Pyramidaloktaeder'-type word describing the passage into the regular octahedron.
'Hinzutreten neuer anderer zu denen der Hauptformen ? gehöriger Flächen' is probably 'Hinzutreten neuer, nicht zu der Hauptform gehöriger Flächen'.
Last line: 'Theil d. neue Fläche ersetzt' is probably 'Theil d. eine (neue) Fläche ersetzt ist (an den Kanten od. Ecken abgestumpft)'.
